A '''Recoil Deflector''' was a component installed on [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn's]] [[PLX-2M portable missile launcher]]. The Deflector was a circular component located behind and wrapping around the [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher's]] [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]].<ref name="EGWT" />
